summary: This stylesheet styles a floating chat bubble widget and its associated panel. The bubble is a circular button fixed in the bottom-right corner with a pulsing ring animation, and when activated it opens a panel above it containing a header with a mascot image and a close button, plus scrollable body content. The entire component scales down on mobile and hides animations for users who prefer reduced motion.

explanations.7: The bubble sits 106 pixels from the bottom, which is carefully calculated to be 16 pixels above a scroll-to-top button that's 60 pixels tall—this prevents accidental taps in the bottom-right corner.
explanations.8: A z-index of 999 ensures this floating button appears above almost everything else on the page.
explanations.20: This groups multiple CSS properties that will animate smoothly over 0.2 seconds when you hover over the button.
explanations.35: This media query detects when a user has enabled 'reduce motion' in their OS settings, so we disable animations for them to avoid causing discomfort.
explanations.51: The `inset` shorthand sets all four sides (top, right, bottom, left) to -4px simultaneously, expanding the ring outward from the button.
explanations.54: The animation runs for 2.2 seconds total and repeats 3 times before stopping—the `ease-out` makes it slow down as it expands.
explanations.55: This prevents the pulsing ring from interfering with mouse clicks or touch interactions.
explanations.100: This sizes the panel to be at most 360 pixels wide, but shrinks it if the screen is too narrow (100vw minus 2rem of margins), ensuring it fits on mobile.
explanations.101: Similarly, the panel's height is limited to 480 pixels but shrinks if needed, leaving at least 200 pixels of space at the bottom.
explanations.107: The panel fades in and scales up slightly from a smaller size when it first appears, creating a polished entrance effect.
explanations.146: This prevents the mascot image from shrinking if other content is trying to compress it.
explanations.147: This ensures the image fills its circular container without distorting.
